page.overview:
Who is George Constantine?

George Constantine (born 22 February 1918 and died 7 January 1968) was an American racing driver. He raced in the 1959 United States Grand Prix at Sebring International Raceway in a owned by Mike Taylor, but retired due to overheating after only 5 laps.

In 1960, he was named the United States Sports Car Driver of the Year. He earned the nickname the "King of Lime Rock" after setting the course record at Lime Rock Park in 1958.
